thread:
anna: Quick follow-up from today’s exec briefing — thanks to everyone who joined. Recording + notes below. TL;DR: product demo went well, Dedicated rollout timeline tightened, and we’re starting a cross-team effort on SLO playbooks. Please add any follow-ups you have.

maria: thanks anna! can you post slides and the recording link? missed last 10m due to swap meeting.

kevin: great demo — PV numbers looked solid. can we get the perf dashboard link for the Dedicated beta? would like to share with partner eng.

eng_bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/1767802468-exec-briefing.mp4 (auto-generated captions available). Transcript processing in progress.

zoe: adding meeting notes here: 1) Dedicated rollout: target beta invite next Tue; 2) SLO playbooks: forming 3-person working groups, ops/platform/rl; 3) Pricing vignette: marketing & finance to sync next week.

sam: for SLO playbooks — can we include a short template? thinking: objective, target metric, warm fallback, runbook link. I can draft.

anna: yes please @sam — that template would be super helpful. Also asking product leads to nominate 1 IC/PM for each playbook by EOD Friday.

kevin: slide link: https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/1767802468-slides.pdf — contains perf charts and rollout timeline (see slide 7).

maria: noted re: nominations. one ask: will the Dedicated beta support region pinning for EU customers? need to loop legal/compliance.

anna: short answer: yes, EU region pinning planned. legal to confirm data residency clauses — @zoe can you coordinate? add legal@redwood to the invite.

zoe: on it. tagging legal now. also putting a calendar hold for the playbook kickoff next Wed 10am PT.

maria: thanks — also, can we get a short public-facing summary for the blog team to use? 2-3 bullets for marketing pls.

kevin: suggested bullets (inline): 1) Dedicated beta opens next week to select partners; 2) Improved latency predictability via reserved pools; 3) New SLO playbooks + runbooks for oncall readiness.

anna: love those. @maria / @kevin please finalize by Thurs so marketing can draft.

eng_bot: Transcript ready: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/1767802468.txt

zoe: follow-ups captured in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/1767802468-followups. I added owners for the kickoff, slides action, and legal check.

sam: will post SLO template draft by EOD tomorrow.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. recording + notes saved in the all-hands folder. If anyone has questions after reviewing, drop them here or ping me directly.

anna: thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. we’ll do a short update in #product next week after kickoff.
